data.description:
ADD THREAD LOCK TO GitAutoCommitter DEBOUNCING

FILE: cortical/reasoning/graph_persistence.py lines 103-105
PROBLEM: Race condition - _debounce_timer accessed without lock
SOLUTION: Add threading.Lock, protect timer/pending_commit access

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
- All tests pass: pytest tests/ -k git -v
- Lock protects _debounce_timer and _pending_commit
- No deadlocks (commit outside lock)

GUARDRAILS - DO NOT:
- Change public API
- Hold lock during git operations
- Modify unrelated classes

VERIFY: pytest tests/unit/test_graph_persistence.py -v
data.title: Add thread lock to GitAutoCommitter debouncing
